question: Who owns Croft's Limited avocado oil brand
markdown:
Crofts Limited
is a Kenyan avocado oil company founded in 2013 and co-owned by
Miraj Shah
(who serves as CEO) and
Mitul Shah
. The company operates out of Thika, Kenya, producing cold-pressed extra virgin and crude avocado oils using a zero-waste process.
